note: The host's own view of a change, in a window of its own (apps/host/ChangesWindow.cpp): what a proposal or a commit changes, file by file, and where an element of the app is written (its Source page). It is read from the host's assets and fed only by the host from the version control, so nothing in the change or the source it shows can alter it. Before an applied change is undone, the host's plan (changes.undoPlan) says which later changes were built on it, and the person chooses: take them out too, leave them, or ask the app's assistant to keep them another way. The action changes.show stands in for the host in scenarios.

computed.extras: {{concat(map(state.view.assets ?? [], it.removed == true ? t('changes.removed', {name: it.name}) : it.name), map(state.view.run ?? [], json(it)))}}
computed.sourceName: {{join(filter([state.source.file, state.source.kind != null ? state.source.kind + ' ' + reverse(split(state.source.address, '/'))[0] : state.source.node, state.source.marked != null ? t('changes.line', {line: state.source.marked}) : null], it != null), ' · ')}}
computed.askText: {{length(state.plan.later ?? []) > 0 ? t('changes.askKeep', {message: state.plan.of.message, n: state.plan.of.number, later: join(map(state.plan.later, t('changes.askLater', {n: it.number, message: it.message})), '; ')}) : t('changes.askUndo', {message: state.plan.of.message, n: state.plan.of.number})}}

changes.refresh.note: Every half second: what the host wants shown, and whether what is shown has moved on

changes.open.note: with: file. The texts of one file, asked for when it is shown: a change's others may be large

changes.showSource.note: with: asked, {source, line} as the app asked: the Source page, in the place of the change; an error from the host stays on it

changes.show.note: For scenarios, in the host's place: event.list (with canAsk), event.view, event.text, event.source, what changes.source answers, for the Source page, and event.plan and event.keepPlan, what changes.undoPlan answers

changes.planUndo.note: What undoing the applied change shown would do, as the host works it out: nothing changes until the person chooses. When later changes were built on it, whether they can stay as they are too

changes.undoDropping.note: Undoes the commit shown and takes out the later changes built on it, as the plan showed them

changes.undoLeaving.note: Undoes the rest of the commit shown and leaves the later changes built on it, as the plan showed them

changes.askUndo.note: Asks the app's assistant to undo the commit shown and keep what was built on it: it answers with a proposal, reviewed like any other

children.goTo: {{state.source.marked != null ? {line: state.source.marked - 1, column: 0, request: state.sourceCount} : null}}

children.text: {{t('changes.by', {author: state.view.author}) + '   ' + t('changes.filesSummary', {n: length(state.view.files), added: computed.added, removed: computed.removed}) + (state.view.impact == null ? '' : '   ' + t('changes.layers', {view: state.view.impact.view, logic: state.view.impact.logic, data: state.view.impact.data}))}}
